actual_actions.reason: Human project direction explicitly rejects treating the existing V43 Prism geometry as mandatory architecture. Prior V43 observations remain valid only within their admitted fit-check/candidate scope.
PLAN-0009 design-intent reconstruction of the V43 Prism chain is no longer the highest-value path because mechanism architecture itself remains open.

conclusion: PLAN-0009 is reconciled without discarding its negative zero-mate result. V43 remains Candidate A research geometry, but the project frontier is broadened to function-first bottle-handling architecture selection. The next plan will freeze mechanism-independent requirements, register multiple candidate mechanism families, and screen them against a common deterministic obligation set before any new candidate CAD is authorized.
